name: Cincy Mahjong Club
description: Cincinnati club offering lessons for all skill levels, leagues and open play at various venues. The club's own page does not say American/NMJL (only third-party listings do), so kept for review.
schedule: Fall 2026 leagues: Tuesday 5:30-8 PM at Fueled Collective (Rookwood Commons) Sept 1-Nov 3; Wednesday 5:30-8 PM at Four Bridges Country Club Sept 23-Nov 18. League fees $250 / $200; membership $150 per fall season or $500 per year.
